messages:
maya chen: quick heads-up — after PTQ bringup of reranker-xl (3B) we see NDCG stable but MRR falling ~6% on the multilang holdout. looks like short queries are worst hit.

samir patel: any chance this is candidate ordering vs scoring change? or tokenizer shift on the short queries?

maya chen: ran a couple of diffs — tokenizer parity checks out, ordering preserved. distribution of token lengths shifted slightly after priming change. short queries (<6 tokens) MRR drop ~12%.

olivia: can you paste the eval command you ran? also what holdout size? we should check CI power.

maya chen: eval command used: 
```
python eval_rerank.py --model reranker-xl-ptq --holdout holdout_v2.json --metrics ndcg@10 mrr@10 --bootstrap 1000
```
holdout_v2 has 5k queries, balanced by language.

deploy-bot: CI job rerank-eval/1824682468 started by maya chen — logs: https://ci.internal/1824682468

diego: 5k might be underpowered for a 6% MRR delta, esp if short-query slice is small. we should do a stratified power calc per slice.

nina: agreed. quick back-of-envelope: for binary-like success at top-1, to detect 6% relative change with alpha=0.05 and power=0.8 you need ~8-10k examples in that slice, depending on variance.

samir patel: propose increasing holdout to 25k overall and reweight samples so short-query slice has >=10k. also run paired bootstrap and a McNemar-style test for top1 flips.

maya chen: will do. also suspect PTQ-induced score compression — top scores compress toward mean, hurting hit@1. can we run a calibration viz (score distribution pre/post)?

olivia: yes — plot histograms and a QQ plot of score differences. also compute self-normalized delta: (score_new - score_old) / score_old.

maya chen: putting together a checklist for the handoff: 
- grow holdout to 25k (stratified by lang + query-length)
- run paired bootstrap (10k) + mcnemar for top1
- produce score-distribution viz + per-lang & per-length breakdowns
- test with reranker-xl quant variants: PTQ-8bit, PTQ-4bit-hybrid
- run single-seed deterministic scoring (no shuffling) to rule out nondet

diego: add: log raw logits + apply same rescoring pipeline offline (no priming change) to isolate priming vs PTQ.

nina: i can help with power calc and stratified sampler script. ping me when you have holdout spec.

maya chen: thanks — i'll create new holdout and kick off runs later today, tagging results in this thread. feel free to drop quick hypotheses here. :mag: :chart_with_downwards_trend:
